posts.author: EpicKitty88
posts.body:
Attached is a picture of one of my Rainbow Caves. In Kitty's Quest, one of my RPGXP games, an anthro named Kitty travels to several different world the find the gems that will save her cats from being hunted by a pack of wolves called the Skylights. The land of the Rainbow Guardians is one of them, and that's where she meets the Fallen Angel, a dark angel.
I'm working on the other six colors of the rainbow (yes, I will have indigo) right now, will post when I have time. Feel free to use this for your work, even though it's not quite finished. It's a simple recolor, I'll probably add more to it later and might repost. Maybe vines, a purple tree, or whatever I think of. Like I said before, this is a work in progress.
Anyway, if you have ideas for an upgraded Violet Cave, feel free to let me know in the comments. Thanks!

posts.body: I didn't just use Photoshop color sliders. Note that having everything in violet took a lot of selecting, otherwise there would have been a little orange, yellow, and red here and there. I am working on updating this one, though, maybe adding some purple vines... don't know yet, but thankfully it's in progress.
